children: Future Vision II Acquisition entered into an unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note for $65,000 with its sponsor to fund a one-month extension of its SPAC deadline. The funds were deposited into the trust account to extend the business combination deadline from September 13, 2026 to October 13, 2026. The note matures upon the closing of the initial business combination and will be forgiven if no deal is completed. At closing, the sponsor may convert the unpaid principal into units at $10.00 per unit.
: Unsecured non-interest promissory note convertible into units at $10.00
: Fund one-month extension of SPAC deadline
